_about: The accessibility scan's baseline (tools/smoke.mjs, area a11y): the findings on 2026-11-13 as signatures (a rule and the element's selector without positions or attribute values; see a11ySig). A new signature fails once the ratchet is on; the screens and markup only name it. Rewrite with: node tools/smoke.mjs --only a11y --a11y-write-baseline (both languages).
